note: Art direction for Domowiki (DW1), redrawn 2026-09-27: naive oil painting after the owner's style reference, a 1999 oil painting of a white church with a brick-red roof under a turquoise sky (thick scraped paint, simplified shapes, muted but clearly coloured). The owner keeps the reference; it is not in the repo. Drawn with: python tools/generate_art.py --set dw1 --model gpt-image-2 --quality high --fidelity high --reference <the church painting, frame cropped off>. One reference at a time: three references at once were averaged into a blander style, and describing the style in our own words (Van Gogh, storybook) overrode the reference.
style: Exactly the same technique, paint texture, brushwork, simplification of shapes, proportions, palette and mood. Follow the painting, not a generic idea of illustration. Keep the painting's COLOUR: it is not monochrome. Use its clear turquoise and sky blues, its brick and rust reds, warm ochre, fresh teal-green, set against whitewash and earth browns, as clearly coloured as the reference: the blue sky and the red roof are the loudest notes. Moderate saturation, never grey, never sepia, never washed out. The subject is the domowik, the old house spirit of Slavic folk belief: a small old man, the size of a cat, with a long grey beard, in plain homespun clothes, barefoot. No text, no letters, no signature, no frame.

subjects.DW1-H01-kitten: Dziadzius, the smallest and youngest-looking domowik of the house, the one everyone loves: tiny, with a short soft white beard, big dark gentle eyes and a too-big rust-red cap, a white shirt, sitting alone on a wooden table in front of a pale turquoise-blue wall, hugging a small golden loaf of bread, looking up with a shy little smile. A red clay jug and a sprig of green beside him.
subjects.DW1-H01-bigcat: Dziadzius, the smallest domowik, now master of the house, seen close: tiny, with a short white beard and a too-big rust-red cap, a white shirt, standing proudly on the whitewashed doorstep of a white cottage, chest out, holding up a small lit lantern, a little black cat sitting beside him looking up at him. Behind him a brick-red roof edge and a turquoise-blue sky with white clouds, ochre and green hills. He fills much of the picture.
subjects.DW1-D01: Stove Keeper. Inside a peasant cottage with walls painted pale turquoise-blue, the domowik, in a rust-red cap and a white linen shirt, sits on the ledge of a big whitewashed clay stove, holding a round loaf of golden-brown bread, orange embers glowing in the stove's mouth, a small window showing blue sky, a red clay jug on the stove.
subjects.DW1-D02: Moving-Day Domowik. When a family moves house they carry the domowik along in an old boot: under a turquoise-blue sky, an old worn brown leather boot sits on a wooden cart piled with bundles and a red chest, and the little domowik in his rust-red cap rides inside the boot, hugging a red clay pot of glowing embers from the old stove. A white cottage with a brick-red roof and ochre hills behind.
subjects.DW1-D03: Mane-Braiding Domowik. In a whitewashed stable with a teal door, the little domowik in a rust-red cap sits on the back of a big calm chestnut horse, braiding its long dark mane into neat little plaits tied with red ribbons.
subjects.DW1-D04: Keeper of the Door. The old domowik, stern and wise, with a long grey beard, sits on the worn wooden threshold of a doorway painted teal-blue with red folk flowers, arms crossed, guarding the house. Whitewashed walls, a turquoise sky visible at the edge.
subjects.DW1-D05: Ovinnik of the Drying Barn: the spirit of the grain-drying barn, a big, shaggy black creature like an enormous black cat with glowing ember-orange eyes, crouching on top of a clay oven inside an old wooden barn hung with golden-ochre sheaves of rye, orange embers below, a small bowl of porridge left for him on the floor.
subjects.DW1-D06: Bread-and-Salt Greeter. The domowik in a rust-red cap and white shirt stands in the open doorway of a white cottage with a brick-red roof, holding out a round braided golden loaf of bread with a little dish of salt on top, resting on a white towel embroidered in red, welcoming a guest. Turquoise sky, green grass.
subjects.DW1-D07: Kikimora, the Night Spinner: a small, thin, bird-like old woman house spirit with a long nose, bright beady eyes and wild grey hair under a red headscarf, in a patched linen dress, sitting by the whitewashed stove at night spinning wool on a wooden distaff and spindle, one candle, deep blue night in the small window, the wool thread pale against the turquoise-blue wall.
subjects.DW1-D08: Dvorovoi, Lord of the Yard: the spirit of the farmyard, a big, broad, shaggy old house spirit, much larger than a domowik, covered in thick brown-grey fur, with a huge beard full of straw and a coarse linen shirt with a red belt, standing in a farmyard by a wattle fence and a wooden well, a hen, a goat and a horse near him. A white cottage with a brick-red roof, turquoise-blue sky, ochre hills.
subjects.DW1-D09: Bowl of Kasha: a simple still life, a red-brown clay bowl of steaming buckwheat porridge with a pat of melting butter and a wooden spoon, left out on the whitewashed ledge of the stove for the house spirit, a turquoise-blue wall behind, a small green sprig beside it. No figure.
subjects.DW1-D10: A Domowik's Temper. The domowik, furious, beard bristling, stamps on a wooden kitchen shelf; red clay pots and jugs tumble through the air, a wooden spoon flies, the turquoise-blue wall behind. Funny and wild, not scary.
subjects.DW1-D11: Saucer of Milk. In a whitewashed barn with a teal door, the domowik in his rust-red cap sets down a white saucer of milk on golden straw; a brown-and-white cow, a goat and a black cat come close to it.
subjects.DW1-D12: Old Bast Shoe: a still life of an old woven bast shoe (a Slavic lapot woven from strips of ochre birch bark), lined with straw, on the wooden floor by a whitewashed stove, a warm orange glow inside it and a small grey-bearded face peeking over its rim. A turquoise-blue wall behind.
subjects.DW1-D13: Domowik in a Cat's Shape. A dark cat sits on a whitewashed stove in a room with pale turquoise-blue walls and a teal door, red clay pots on a shelf; on the wall behind it the cat's shadow is the shadow of a little bearded old man in a pointed cap.
subjects.DW1-D14: Babunia, the domowik's old wife: a small old woman house spirit in a rust-red headscarf and a white apron, standing at the wooden door of an earth cellar dug into a grassy green-and-ochre hillside under a turquoise-blue sky, holding up a jar of bright red cherry preserves, shelves of jars of red, orange and green preserves behind her.
subjects.DW1-D15: Bannik of the Bathhouse: the spirit of the bathhouse, a wiry, wild-haired old man with a long wet grey beard and fierce bright eyes, wrapped in a white linen towel, sitting on the top bench of a small wooden Slavic bathhouse full of white steam, holding a bundle of green birch twigs, a red-hot stone stove glowing orange.
subjects.DW1-D16: Hearth Cricket: a small green house cricket with long antennae sitting on a warm red brick at the foot of the whitewashed stove, orange embers glowing in the stove's mouth, a tiny wooden bowl of crumbs beside it. A simple painting of a small creature, large in the frame.
subjects.DW1-D17: The House Snake: a small grass snake, glossy dark olive with two bright yellow patches behind its head, curled by an old wooden doorstep painted with red folk flowers, sipping from a white saucer of milk left out for it. Whitewashed wall, green grass. Calm, not scary.
subjects.DW1-D18: Klobuk, the Soggy Chick: a little Polish household spirit that looks like a completely soaked black chick, small and round with droopy wet feathers and bright golden eyes, sitting on a wattle fence in the rain at dusk; behind it a white cottage with a brick-red roof and one warm yellow window, the sky a stormy turquoise-grey.
subjects.DW1-D19: Warm Hand in the Night: a child asleep in a wooden bed under a quilt with red and white folk patterns, in a room with a deep blue night window; a small old hand with a white linen sleeve reaches in from the side and rests gently on the child's cheek. The child smiles in sleep.
subjects.DW1-D20: Knotted Mane: in a whitewashed stable at dawn, a big grumpy chestnut horse with its long dark mane tangled into a wild mess of knots, and the tiny domowik in a rust-red cap tugging mischievously on the knots from its neck, the horse rolling its eyes.

referenceLead: This oil painting is by a painter. Paint a NEW oil painting by the same painter, as if from the same series.
